licenses.text:
Darby Translation, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engDBY/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation):
> "Public Domain
Language: English
Dialect: archaic British
Translation by: J. N. Darby"
(from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engDBY/copyright.htm)

Why this is public domain:
Translator: John Nelson Darby, 1800-1882 (died 1882, United Kingdom). The edition used is the 1884 printing (the eBible/Crosswire module name is engDBY1884eb). Its US status: published in 1884, before 1931, so public domain in the United States. Its origin-country status: Darby died in 1882 in the United Kingdom, so the work is public domain there under life plus 70 years (expired 1953). No other translator or reviser is named by eBible for this text.

Sources of these facts:
eBible.org copyright page (https://ebible.org/engDBY/copyright.htm) and details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engDBY); Darby's life dates from English Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Nelson_Darby).

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
